verdict.rationale: Text was extracted from several ised-isde.canada.ca guidance pages (how-to-incorporate, fees and processing times, annual return, home page), which implies the public reading surface serves readable content rather than a JS-only shell. A keyless GET to the related open.canada.ca API also returned HTTP 200 with JSON. However, no probe directly tested the Corporations Canada guidance pages with an identified user agent, so the absence of a bot wall or CAPTCHA is inferred, not observed. Missing for 10: a direct keyless probe of the ised-isde.canada.ca guidance pages with a declared user agent, explicit confirmation of no bot wall or CAPTCHA, and independent corroboration of agent reachability.
